title: An octanuclear Mn4IIIDy4III cluster connected via two μ5-NO3− bridges with slow relaxation of magnetization

material_class.structural_family: nearly planar butterfly Mn4Dy4 core templated by two μ5-NO3 bridges

synthesis.procedure: Mn(ClO4)2·6H2O (0.50 mmol, 0.181 g), Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.10 mmol, 0.035 g) and Hmbm (0.857 mmol, 0.137 g) were dissolved in 30 mL MeCN/MeOH (v/v = 2:1). Triethylamine (0.75 mmol, 0.11 mL) was added with stirring. The dark-brown solution was stirred for another hour, filtered, and the filtrate was left undisturbed at ambient temperature. Large dark-brown crystals were collected by filtration after two weeks. The main text gives the same reagents and MeOH/MeCN (1/2, v/v) but without reagent quantities.
synthesis.time: stirred 1 h; crystallization for two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by filtration and undisturbed crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtrate left undisturbed at ambient temperature; dark-brown crystals collected by filtration after two weeks

properties.summary: dc susceptibility shows χMT falling from 63.76 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K to 27.31 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K, attributed to Dy Stark depopulation and possible antiferromagnetic exchange. Reduced-magnetization isotherms do not superimpose, indicating strong anisotropy, and M reaches 29.9 Nβ at 7 T and 1.8 K without saturation. Zero-field ac data show frequency-dependent out-of-phase signals but no peaks down to 1.8 K, so the barrier and relaxation time were not determined; probable SMM behavior with blocking temperature below 1.8 K.

measurements.name: theoretical uncoupled χMT
measurements.conditions: four Mn(III) (g = 2.0, S = 2) and four Dy(III) (6H15/2)

measurements.name: ac susceptibility
measurements.conditions: zero dc field, 5 Oe oscillating field, T < 10 K; frequency-dependent χ″, no maxima to 1.8 K; Ueff and τ not determined
